Overhead Crane Certification requires that you complete all 3 activities to attain certification. AGGU will mark the Skills Test activity complete in the LMS after the instructor submits the Operating Skills Test. This training complies with OSHA standards.

Job Relations (JR) is a fundamental element of Lean and an important component of TWI. Its purpose is to develop the skill of leading. Used correctly JR will help supervisors, and any other leader of people, avoid problems though proven principles. And if problems do arise JR provides a 4-step process for handling the situation in a fact based, non-emotional, manner. The "Learner" version of this JR course can be used to facilitate your own 5-day, in person, JR course. A detailed facilitators guide is also available which includes a day-by-day agenda.

This curriculum contains 5 activities which must be fulfilled in order to receive full First Aid/CPR/AED certification; Note: First Aid/CPR/AED Class will be held at each AGG location - you will be notified of the scheduled training date, and AGGU will mark the training complete in the LMS after the instructor submits the attendance roster. This curriculum of activities complies with OSHA standards.
Hearing Conservation Program(referred to as 'Parent') requires that you complete 2 activities. This training complies with OSHA standard 1910.95.
